story_text: As a guest, I want the system to reject a booking with 0 guests so that only valid guest counts are accepted.

positive.title: Book with 0 guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking API
2. fill in all fields with valid data
3. Fill the guests field with 0
4. Click submit
positive.expected_result: Error message clearly states guest count must be greater than zero

positive.title: Validate booking with 0 guests error message to be precise
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking API
2. fill in all fields with valid data
3. Fill the guests field with 0
4. Click submit
5. Check the error message
positive.expected_result: Error message clearly states guest count must be greater than zero

negative.title: Book with negative number of guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking API
2. fill in all fields with valid data
3. Fill the guests field with negative number
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: Error message clearly states guest count must be greater than zero

edge.title: Booking with 0 guests submitted as a string '0' is rejected
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking API
2. fill in all fields with valid data
3. Fill the guests field with '0'
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: Error message clearly states guest count must be greater than zero

edge.title: Booking with [null] guest count is rejected
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking API
2. fill in all fields with valid data
3. Fill the guests field with null
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: Error message clearly states guest count must be greater than zero
